name: Cochrane Risk of Bias 2 (RoB 2) Causal Evaluation Framework
authority: Cochrane Collaboration / Sterne et al., BMJ (2019) 366:l4898
domain: Epidemiology, Interventional Trials, Causal Inference & Clinical Validity

domains.name: Domain 1: Bias Arising from the Randomization / Allocation Process
domains.description: True randomized allocation sequence with robust allocation concealment preventing selection bias; verifies baseline equivalence across experimental and control arms.

domains.name: Domain 2: Bias Due to Deviations from Intended Interventions
domains.description: Double-blinding or masking of participants and experimental agents; absence of experimental contamination or unapproved co-interventions; intention-to-treat (ITT) adherence.

domains.name: Domain 3: Bias Due to Missing Outcome Data (Attrition & Dropouts)
domains.description: Outcome data available for nearly all enrolled participants (> 80% completers); reasons for missing data documented and balanced across arms with sensitivity analysis.

domains.name: Domain 4: Bias in Measurement of the Outcome
domains.description: Outcome assessors blinded to assignment; measurement methods objective, validated, and applied identically across arms; free from detection bias.

domains.name: Domain 5: Bias in Selection of the Reported Result
domains.description: Outcomes analyzed strictly in accordance with a pre-registered, pre-specified trial protocol; all pre-specified primary and secondary endpoints reported without selective cherry-picking.
